entries.en: So sleepy... This class is boring...

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Hey, [lName]!

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: You! Pay attention! Is that how you listen[n]when someone's talking to you!?
entries.uk: Ти! Будь уважним! Хіба так слухають,[n]коли до тебе говорять!?

entries.en: He's going to throw chalk![n]What should I do!?
Dodge on instinct
Wait until the last moment
Don't dodge it

entries.speaker: Female Student
entries.en: Whoa! That was an epic dodge!

entries.speaker: Male Student
entries.en: I can't believe he dodged Ushimaru's[n]throw... Is he a ninja?
entries.uk: Не віриться, що він ухилився від кидка[n]Ушімару... Він що, ніндзя?

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: So you were awake... Hmph.[n]I couldn't even tell.
entries.uk: То ти не спав... Хмф.[n]А я й не помітив.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Oh well. Moving on.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like you made the right choice!

entries.speaker: Female Student
entries.en: Ooh... That looked like it hurt.

entries.speaker: Male Student
entries.en: *snicker* He hit him right in the[n]forehead...

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: That's what you get for nodding off.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Kids these days have no respect[n]for their elders.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Aw, man... You messed up.

entries.speaker: Female Student
entries.en: Huh? It's like he doesn't even care...

entries.speaker: Male Student
entries.en: Whoa... That's badass!

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: ...What's with that look you're giving me?
entries.uk: ...Що це ти так на мене дивишся?

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Tch... Well, whatever. Moving on.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I like that aura you've got about you—[n]not retreating even a single step.
entries.uk: Мені подобається ця твоя аура —[n]ні кроку назад.
